rows.value: MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline (OpenGWAS ukb-b)
rows.quote: Colon cancer GWAS data were sourced from the IEU GWAS catalog (UKB-B-20145). <bold>Results</bold> : In this study, we identified onemediating relationship between inflammation, lipid, and colon cancer.
rows.coder_note: The accession UKB-B-20145 is an IEU OpenGWAS identifier of the ukb-b batch, which the MRC-IEU UK Biobank GWAS pipeline row registers (name and alias ukb-b); the accession is written in upper case (rule A) and nothing conflicts. The code rests on the accession, not on a cohort name.
